blocks.text: 🏮 Our Kyoto Adventure · 3 Days
Torii gates, bamboo forests, monkeys, golden temples and a lot of good food — here's the plan!

groups.label: Day 1 · Torii gates & the river 🚶 all on foot

items.title: Fushimi Inari
items.note: Beat the crowds — thousands of orange gates to run through. Fox statues everywhere!

items.title: Nishiki Market
items.note: Graze your way down the street: skewers, sweets, tamagoyaki. Everyone picks their own snack.

items.title: Kamo River stroll
items.note: Easy wind-down walk as the light goes gold. Look for herons.

items.title: Bamboo Grove
items.note: Towering green stalks that creak in the wind — go early for the quiet magic.

items.title: Monkey Park
items.note: A climb with a payoff: wild monkeys and the best view over Kyoto. Kids' favourite!

items.title: Tea house stop
items.note: Matcha and wagashi sweets — a calm pause for tired legs.

items.title: Ramen night
items.note: Steaming bowls all round. Slurping encouraged.

groups.label: Day 3 · Gold, rocks & trains 🚌 bus day

items.title: Kinkaku-ji
items.note: A temple covered in real gold leaf, mirrored in the pond. Bring cameras.

items.title: Ryoan-ji
items.note: 15 rocks — but you can never see all 15 at once from any spot. Family challenge: try!

items.title: Kyoto Railway Museum
items.note: The kids' reward: real steam trains, simulators, and a turntable show.

items.title: Farewell izakaya
items.note: Small plates for everyone — toast the trip with something fizzy.

blocks.title: Getting around
blocks.text: Day 1 we walk everywhere — comfy shoes on! Days 2 and 3 we ride the bus: grab an IC card (ICOCA/Suica) so nobody has to fish for coins.

blocks.text: Kyoto with the Family · 3 Days
Torii gates, bamboo forests, monkeys, gold temples and a lot of noodles. Here's our adventure, day by day.

groups.label: Day 1 · On Foot — gates, snacks & riverside

items.title: Fushimi Inari
items.note: Beat the crowds! Thousands of orange torii gates to wander through — count the fox statues along the way.

items.title: Nishiki Market
items.note: "Kyoto's Kitchen" — graze your way down the street: skewers, mochi, tamagoyaki. Everyone picks their own treats.

items.title: Kamo River stroll
items.note: A slow walk along the water as the light fades. Herons, stepping stones, and tired happy legs.

groups.label: Day 2 · By Bus — bamboo, monkeys & ramen

items.title: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
items.note: Walk through towering green stalks that creak in the wind — it sounds like another world.

items.title: Monkey Park
items.note: A climb up the hill, then wild monkeys roaming free with the whole city at your feet. Kids' favourite, guaranteed.

items.title: Tea house stop
items.note: Sit down, sip matcha, try a wagashi sweet. A calm pause before the evening.

items.title: Ramen night
items.note: Steaming bowls all around. Slurping is encouraged — it's polite here!

groups.label: Day 3 · By Bus — gold, rocks & trains

items.title: Kinkaku-ji
items.note: The Golden Pavilion — a temple covered in real gold leaf, mirrored in the pond. Photo stop!

items.title: Ryoan-ji
items.note: Japan's most famous rock garden. Family game: count the 15 stones — you can never see them all at once from any spot.

items.title: Kyoto Railway Museum
items.note: The kids' reward: real steam locomotives, train simulators, and a ride on a working steam engine.

items.title: Farewell izakaya
items.note: One last table full of small plates — yakitori, gyoza, rice balls. Toast the trip with juice and tea.

blocks.title: Getting around
blocks.text: Day 1 we walk everywhere — comfy shoes on! Days 2 and 3 we ride the bus: hop on at the back, pay when you get off at the front. Kids will love watching the stops tick by.

blocks.title: Family trip bingo — spot them all!
items: A fox statue holding a key (Fushimi Inari)
A heron by the Kamo river
Your reflection in the Golden Pavilion pond
All 15 rocks at once at Ryoan-ji (impossible — try anyway!)
A steam train that actually runs

blocks.text: 🏮 Our Kyoto Adventure · 3 Days
Torii gates, bamboo forests, monkeys, gold temples and a lot of noodles — here's the plan!

groups.label: Day 1 · Torii gates & the river 🚶 on foot all day

items.title: Fushimi Inari Shrine
items.note: Thousands of orange gates up the mountain. Go early to beat the crowds — fox statues everywhere, count them as you climb!

items.title: Nishiki Market
items.note: 'Kyoto's kitchen' — snack your way down the arcade: tamagoyaki skewers, mochi, fresh juices. Everyone picks their own treat.

items.title: Kamo River stroll
items.note: Easy sunset walk along the water. Look for herons, and do the famous stepping stones if you dare.

items.title: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
items.note: Walk through towering green stalks that creak in the wind — sounds like another planet. Early = fewer people in photos.

items.title: Monkey Park Iwatayama
items.note: A short uphill hike, then wild monkeys roaming free and the best view over Kyoto. Kids feed them from inside the hut!

items.title: Tea house stop
items.note: Matcha and sweets with a garden view — a calm break for tired legs.

items.title: Ramen night
items.note: Steaming bowls for everyone. Slurping is polite here — family slurping contest encouraged.

groups.label: Day 3 · Gold, rocks & trains 🚌 bus day

items.title: Kinkaku-ji, the Golden Pavilion
items.note: A temple covered in real gold leaf, mirrored in the pond. Straight off a postcard.

items.title: Ryoan-ji rock garden
items.note: 15 famous rocks — but from any spot you can only see 14. Family challenge: can anyone spot all 15?

items.title: Kyoto Railway Museum
items.note: The kids' pick: real steam locomotives, train simulators, and a steam train ride.

items.title: Farewell izakaya
items.note: One last feast of small plates — yakitori, gyoza, rice balls. Toast the trip with everyone's favourite moment.

blocks.title: Getting around
blocks.text: Day 1 is a walking day — comfy shoes for everyone. Days 2 and 3 we ride the bus: grab an IC card (ICOCA/Suica) so boarding is tap-and-go, and kids under 6 ride free.

items: IC cards loaded for bus days
